name: Serf
firstNightReminder: Wake up the serf and show them the character token of an in-play good character.
otherNightReminder: If a player with the previously known character has died since last dawn, wake up the serf and show them the character token of an in-play good character.
ability: You start knowing 1 in-play good character. If a player with the character you know dies, you learn another in-play good character tonight.[+0/1 Outsider]
